title: Federal American Eagle 9mm 115gr FMJ — 250 rounds
why: About 26¢ a round for brass-case FMJ. Big-box counters have been closer to 36¢ on the same 250-round pack.

title: Anker 521 Portable Power Station (256Wh)
why: Enough stored power for phones, a radio, and a small fan. Anker’s own price has been sitting near $280.

title: Glock 19 Gen5 MOS 9mm
why: Department trade-in Gen5 MOS pistols still list nearer $620 when sold as new. A used police trade-in under $500 is the one that sells through.

title: Streamlight ProTac HL-X
why: The default 1,000-lumen weapon light on a lot of builds. A used HL-X under $90 sits below the usual street price for a new one.

title: Holosun HS403B Micro Red Dot
why: Agency trade-in of the usual first red dot. It has not spent much time this far under $200.

title: LifeStraw Personal Water Filter
why: A small dollar cut on a filter whose shelf price barely moves. Easy spare for a glovebox or day pack.

title: Augason Farms 30-Day Emergency Food Kit
why: A one-person 30-day bucket under $120. The same kit has been listing closer to $170.

title: Hornady Critical Defense 9mm 115gr — 25 rounds
why: Defensive 9mm rarely prints under $1 a round. This box does, and it is not tied to a bulk-club login.

title: Ruger 10/22 Carbine .22 LR
why: Used wood-stock carbine, not a rebate bundle. Everyday new pricing has been stuck just over $300.

title: SOL Emergency Bivvy — 2 pack
why: Two heat-reflective bivvies for the price one usually costs. Worth a slot in a vehicle kit before cold weather.

title: Magpul PMAG 30 AR/M4 Gen M3 — 10 pack
why: Ten magazines at about $10 each. Sold one at a time, the same Gen M3 still rings up near $15.

title: Smith & Wesson M&P15 Sport III 5.56
why: Sport III rifles have been sticky around $800 new. This one is a police trade-in, not a blemished new gun.

title: Vortex Diamondback 4-12x40 BDC
why: A third off a Diamondback that still carries Vortex VIP warranty. MAP has been keeping street prices nearer $260.

title: Mountain House Classic Bucket — 24 servings
why: Just over $3 a serving for freeze-dried entrees with a long shelf life. Recent club pricing has been nearer $4.50.

title: Winchester 5.56 55gr M193 — 150 rounds
why: About 59¢ a round for M193-style brass. Recent case splits have been closer to 75¢.

title: Sig Sauer Romeo5 1x20mm
why: New Romeo5 street price has settled around $160. This used unit is under that, and it is not a parts gun.

title: Adventure Medical Kits Sportsman 200
why: A compact kit for blisters, cuts, and the small stuff. Replacing the contents one packet at a time costs more than the kit.

title: Blue Force Gear Vickers Combat Sling
why: Padded Vickers slings rarely print under $55. This is the standard black sling, not a closeout colorway.

title: PackFreshUSA 1-Gallon Mylar Bags with Oxygen Absorbers — 50
why: Bags and absorbers in one carton for dry staples. Buying the two pieces separately has been landing near $50.

title: BLACK+DECKER 20V MAX Drill/Driver Kit
why: Battery, charger, and a basic household drill at 40% off. It is a home kit, not a jobsite driver.

title: Steam Deck OLED 512GB
why: OLED 512GB decks rarely move off the $549 shelf price. A hundred off is the cut that shows up in the gaming aisle.

title: Logitech G502 X Lightspeed
why: The wireless G502 X has been holding near $140. This used unit is under $90, not a refurbished mystery SKU.

title: DJI Mini 4 Pro (drone only)
why: Drone-only Mini 4 Pro, no Fly More kit. Street price on the bare aircraft has been closer to $900.

title: DJI Neo
why: Used Neo, not the Motion Fly More bundle. New ones have been sitting at $199.
